name: 档案逾期未归还查询
description: 查询逾期未归还的档案借阅记录
statement: SELECT b.borrow_no, b.archive_no, b.borrower, b.borrow_date, b.plan_return_date, b.borrow_status FROM 档案借阅表 b WHERE b.borrow_status <> '已归还' AND b.plan_return_date < CURRENT_DATE
sql: SELECT b.borrow_no, b.archive_no, b.borrower, b.borrow_date, b.plan_return_date, b.borrow_status FROM 档案借阅表 b WHERE b.borrow_status <> '已归还' AND b.plan_return_date < CURRENT_DATE
